name: STAT 5865
title: Deep Learning
description: Foundations of modern deep learning including the statistical learning framework, optimization and gradient descent, and various learning algorithms such as multi-layer perceptrons, convolutional neural networks, transformers, and more.
requirement_description: STAT 5545 and STAT 5505; or instructor consent. Not open for credit to students who have passed STAT 5095 when offered as "Deep Learning."
